description: The person's own AI settings (L36 Y1): GET /api/v1/me/credentials lists the provider keys they hold themselves, never a key (a four-character hint only), and GET /api/v1/me/ai/preferences reads how their runs route. Only the person may call it — their Network user token, or the person session on AI's own site behind a same-origin check. A service token is refused, and so is any token carrying on_behalf_of, whatever capabilities it holds.
